caption: A circular concrete pipe is viewed head-on under harsh, uneven lighting. The walls are dark gray, rough, and damp-looking, with a shallow dark water area along the bottom. The lower half is covered by a large pale gray-white, lumpy, crusty mass with yellow-brown patches. Irregular raised slabs and jagged edges extend upward near the center, with a dark narrow line on the upper-right wall.

A large circular concrete pipe fills the image, viewed slightly downward. The gray-lavender surface is rough and damp, with reflective wet patches. Pale whitish streaks and crusty areas spread across the upper and side walls. A dark vertical band runs down the center, ending near shallow dark water and scattered light fragments at the bottom. A large dark circular patch with a pale outline is visible in the lower center.

A circular concrete pipe is viewed in dim, uneven lighting. The gray interior is wet and reflective, with shallow dark water along the bottom. Pale yellow-gray, rough, crusty material covers much of the lower center and right wall, with smaller patches on the upper-left. A large uneven dark opening appears in the center, surrounded by jagged, irregular edges and protruding chunks.

Gray concrete pipe interior with rough, damp walls and shallow water flowing along the bottom. Dense pale white, string-like material hangs from the upper left and upper right walls, forming uneven curtains around a dark central opening. Brown and greenish staining appears on the lower central surfaces, with irregular ledges and small protruding strands along the waterline. Bright camera lighting creates strong glare on the wet areas.

A circular concrete pipe extends into a hazy distance. The walls are dark gray, rough, and visibly wet, with a horizontal waterline across the lower half and shallow water containing pale floating patches. A narrow, jagged vertical line runs from the top center downward. Scattered small pale yellow-white spots appear on the walls, with heavier whitish buildup around the lower center.

A circular gray concrete pipe is viewed toward a smaller, darker opening in the distance. Dim camera lighting illuminates rough, grainy walls. Shallow dark water runs along the lower-left side. The bottom and lower-right area are covered by a large uneven mound of gray, brown, black, and pale material, with scattered yellow and orange pieces. A narrow reddish-brown vertical stain appears on the left wall, and several wall seams are visible.

A circular gray concrete pipe is viewed toward a darker, smaller opening. The walls are rough, mottled, and wet-looking, with bright reflective patches. Pale beige and white crusty material covers much of the lower foreground and forms irregular ledges across the bottom center. A dark open gap lies beneath these ledges, with uneven broken-looking edges. Thin dark vertical streaks appear on the side walls.

A large circular gray concrete pipe extends into a dark, narrowing distance. The lower portion contains a shallow stream of dark water with scattered pale, tan, and brown gritty fragments. The walls are rough and damp, with darker wet staining along the bottom and lower sides. A prominent curved joint band is visible on the left, with faint vertical lines on the walls.

A circular light-gray concrete pipe extends into a dark central tunnel. The walls are rough and damp, with pale whitish patches and darker wet staining along the lower half. Shallow dark water runs along the bottom center. Tangled thin fibrous strands and debris lie across the lower-left and center floor, with a few strands projecting toward the middle. A dark vertical streak is visible on the inner lower-right wall.

A circular concrete pipe extends into a dark central opening under camera illumination. The walls are light gray, rough, mottled, and damp, with darker wet staining along the lower half. A shallow, dark water film covers the bottom. The right wall has a narrow dark vertical groove bordered by a brown patch with many thin strands. Irregular dark patches appear around the distant opening.

A circular gray concrete pipe extends into a dark central opening. The walls are rough, speckled, and damp with a slight reflective sheen. Shallow dark water covers the bottom. Brown tangled fibrous clumps project inward from both lower side edges, with thin pale strands hanging from the upper center. A dark narrow channel runs along the bottom center.

A gray, circular concrete pipe interior fills the frame under dim, diffuse lighting. The wall is rough and mottled, with scattered pale and darker gray patches and a slight damp sheen. A narrow, dark, jagged vertical line runs down the left side. The center and right walls appear broadly uniform, with no visible water surface, holes, protrusions, or major deformation.

A circular gray concrete pipe with rough, granular walls and damp, darkened patches along the lower sides. Shallow water runs along the bottom. At the far end, an irregular dark, fibrous mass spans the lower opening, with pale gray clumps on both sides. A narrow dark strip hangs vertically from the top center. Small green and brown fragments lie near the bottom-right edge.

A circular gray concrete pipe is viewed toward a dark central opening. Camera lighting highlights rough, damp walls with mottled pale gray, brown, and purple staining. Shallow water or a wet reflective surface covers the bottom. The lower wall has uneven layered material, thin dark branching lines, and jagged recessed areas; the right side shows a lighter irregular patch. Blackness fills the deepest center.

A circular concrete pipe extends into a dark central opening. Gray walls show dense vertical and ring-like ridges, with wet reflective surfaces. Shallow murky water runs along the bottom center. Pale beige and white crusty patches cover much of the lower-left and lower-right walls, with a rough, broken-looking raised area along the bottom edge. A dark vertical streak follows the lower center.

A circular gray concrete pipe recedes toward a dark central opening. The walls are rough and mottled, with damp-looking surfaces and uneven pale-gray patches. A darker vertical stained band runs along the right wall, while brownish marks appear near the upper-right edge. The lower center is very dark, with a narrow reflective-looking area suggesting a low water level.

A circular concrete pipe is viewed from inside, with bright illumination near the center and darker edges. The gray, rough walls appear damp, with pale and yellow-brown staining, especially along the upper and side surfaces. Shallow dark water covers the bottom, where several irregular stones and small debris are gathered. Thin pale strands hang along the right wall, with additional dark vertical lines and uneven surface patches visible around the opening.

A circular concrete pipe interior is brightly lit toward the lower center, with darker shadowing along the upper edge. The gray, rough, uneven walls have pale beige and yellow-brown patches. The bottom third contains irregular pale crusty material and broken-looking lumps. Several thin reddish-brown linear pieces cross the central lower area, with a dark curved strip near center-right. No standing water is visible.

A circular concrete pipe extends into a dark central tunnel. The gray walls are rough and wet-looking, with vertical brown and dark streaks, especially along the lower sides. The bottom is covered by uneven gray-brown gravel and small debris, rising toward the center, with no visible standing water. Bright whitish illumination reflects off the upper-right wall. Thin dark strands hang near the left-center opening.

A round gray concrete pipe is viewed head-on in dim lighting. The lower section contains shallow dark water, scattered stones, and irregular chunks of debris. The concrete is rough and damp, with pale white vertical streaks and yellow-brown staining. Numerous thick brown, fibrous strands hang along the left side and extend across the bottom; similar strands appear at the right edge.

A circular concrete pipe interior is shown under dim illumination, with the lower portion nearly black and a shallow dark water surface at the bottom. The gray-brown walls are rough and wet-looking. A pale crusty patch covers much of the upper-right wall, with yellow-brown staining beside it. Numerous thin pale strands hang across the upper center, and a dark vertical groove runs down the right wall.

A circular concrete pipe opening is centered in the scene, with a dark inner tunnel. Shallow gray water covers the bottom foreground. Rough, wet gray concrete surrounds the opening. A pale yellow-brown stained patch appears on the upper-left wall, while reddish-orange rectangular patches line the right wall. A mound of dark gravel and scattered light-colored stones lies beneath the opening, with uneven broken-looking edges around the base.

Interior of a rounded concrete pipe, viewed close-up under dim lighting. The gray-purple surface is rough and damp, with pale yellow and brown staining concentrated along the lower half and sides. A dark, uneven horizontal gap runs across the lower center, bordered by jagged edges and small raised fragments. A few thin dark strands appear along the left side. No clear water surface is visible.

A gray concrete pipe interior is lit by a bright central inspection light. The upper and side surfaces are rough and mottled, with damp-looking patches. A pale gray, smoother lower section reflects the light and appears partially covered by shallow water. A dark horizontal band runs across the middle, with a narrow yellow-brown patch near the upper center. The pipe walls have uneven contours and small dark specks.

A close view inside a roughly circular concrete pipe. The upper wall is gray, rough, and uneven, with exposed aggregate. A horizontal yellow-brown stained band runs across the middle-right area. A dark, irregular horizontal groove or gap separates the upper wall from the pale lower surface. The bottom is light gray and wet-looking, with bright reflected illumination and a shallow dark water line.

A circular gray concrete pipe is viewed under uneven artificial lighting, with a bright reflection along the lower center and shallow dark water at the bottom. The walls are rough and mottled, with pale gray crusty patches concentrated around the center. A reddish-brown rectangular strip is visible near the middle, surrounded by irregular raised material and several thin dark lines.

Circular concrete pipe interior with pale gray, rough, damp walls under dim lighting. A shallow dark water area covers the bottom. A small orange-rimmed circular opening appears in the upper-left wall. Dark vertical streaks descend along the right wall, with a broad dark vertical form near the lower-left center. An uneven darker horizontal band crosses the lower-right wall, and faint green markings are visible on both side walls.

A circular gray concrete pipe fills the view, with a dark round opening centered in the distance. The walls are rough, uneven, and wet, with pale gray patches and yellow-brown staining, especially along the lower edges. Dark water covers the bottom, mixed with leaves and loose debris. Several areas along both lower side walls have jagged, missing sections and irregular protruding edges.

A gray, roughly cylindrical concrete interior fills the frame under bright camera lighting. The surface is rough and mottled, with pale whitish patches across the center and upper-right and yellow-brown staining near the upper-left. Dark damp-looking areas run along the lower wall. An uneven horizontal dark line crosses the lower-middle area, with a jagged wider gap toward the bottom. No standing water is visible. A black camera fixture occupies the left edge.

A circular gray concrete pipe recedes toward a smaller central opening. The walls are rough and uneven, with damp reflective areas and pale whitish streaks, especially along the upper and side surfaces. A yellow-brown band surrounds the inner opening, which appears nearly black. A shallow dark water layer is visible at the bottom, with faint brown discoloration along the lower wall.

A circular gray concrete pipe is viewed straight into its dark, narrowing interior. The walls are smooth to moderately rough and damp, with glossy black water or wetness along the bottom. A yellow-brown curved stain appears on the lower-left inner wall, with scattered pale specks around the rim. The upper walls are evenly gray-purple under camera lighting; no major deformation or open hole is visible.

Circular pipe interior viewed toward a dark central opening. Pale gray concrete walls are rough and damp-looking, with a broad yellow-brown stained band around the upper and side areas. The bottom contains uneven gray rubble and sediment-like material, with a shallow dark wet area. A dark vertical seam or line is visible along the right side, and the lower wall edge is irregular.

A circular concrete pipe extends into a dark central tunnel. The gray walls are rough, uneven, and damp, with pale yellow-brown staining mainly along the upper-left and left interior. Dark vertical bands appear on both side walls, with uneven recessed edges around them. A shallow, reflective layer of dark water covers the bottom, with lighter wet streaks near the center. Lighting is brighter at the entrance and fades toward the tunnel.

A cylindrical concrete pipe extends toward a dark circular opening. Pale gray walls have a smooth-to-rough mottled texture, with a narrow dark vertical line along the left wall and faint horizontal marks on the right. Shallow brownish water covers the bottom, with yellow-brown staining and uneven granular buildup along the lower sides. Lighting is brighter near the camera and fades into darkness toward the center.

A circular gray concrete pipe is viewed head-on, with concentric ring-like sections narrowing toward a dark central opening. The surface is rough and mottled, with darker damp areas along the lower portion. Shallow dark water is visible at the bottom. A pale gray, irregular angular piece protrudes from the lower center-right edge, with a dark vertical streak beneath it.

A circular gray concrete pipe extends into a dark central opening. The walls are smooth to moderately rough, with faint vertical lines and uneven pale-gray shading. A shallow, dark reflective water layer appears along the bottom. Near the lower center is a small brownish patch with several light-colored irregular pieces. A darker ring-shaped joint surrounds the inner opening, and faint narrow lines run along the side walls.

Circular gray concrete pipe viewed toward a darker round opening. The walls are rough and damp, with dim lighting and a shallow reflective water layer along the bottom. A narrow yellow-brown irregular streak runs diagonally on the lower-left wall, with faint pale streaks nearby. Subtle dark vertical shading appears below the central opening; no obvious holes or protruding shapes are visible.

A circular concrete pipe recedes into a dark central opening. Pale gray walls have rough, mottled surfaces with damp-looking areas and yellow-brown staining, especially along the upper-left and right sides. A pale crusty band covers much of the lower wall. Shallow dark water lies along the bottom, with an irregular raised strip or broken-looking edge near the foreground center.

A circular gray concrete pipe extends into a dark round opening. Dim lighting reveals damp, rough walls with pale whitish patches along the lower sides. Shallow murky water covers the floor, which is uneven and crowded with brown-gray fragments and flattened material. The far wall has irregular dark lines and uneven edges, with a small raised area near the lower center.

A circular pale-gray concrete pipe extends into a dark central opening. The walls are rough and uneven, with damp-looking surfaces and darker gray-brown staining along the lower section. A shallow dark water channel runs along the bottom. A narrow dark vertical streak appears on the right wall, with a darker ring-like joint around the inner opening.

Circular concrete pipe viewed from inside, with a dark central opening and bright camera lighting on the pale gray walls. The surface is rough and mottled, with damp brown-yellow staining and muddy material across the bottom. A shallow water sheen appears along the lower channel. Irregular rough, chipped-looking edges and thin dark lines are visible near the lower left and lower right wall junctions.

A circular gray concrete pipe recedes into a dark center under dim lighting. The walls are smooth to rough and damp, with a shallow dark water channel along the bottom. Yellow-brown staining follows the lower side edges, especially left and right. Thin pale branching lines cross the upper and side walls, with a small bright protrusion near the upper-right wall.

A circular gray-violet concrete pipe fills the frame, lit by the inspection camera. The walls are rough, damp, and reflective, with pale vertical streaks and darker smudging. A circular ring surrounds the passage near the center. The passage narrows into a very dark opening, with a brownish wet area along the lower center. A thin pale diagonal line crosses the view.

A cylindrical gray concrete pipe fills the frame, with a dark circular continuation ahead. The walls are rough, damp, and unevenly lit. Shallow brown water covers the bottom, with pale crusty bands along both lower sides. Yellow-brown staining appears on the lower-right wall. Small light-colored angular pieces and uneven protrusions are visible near the center bottom.

A circular concrete pipe extends into a dark central opening under dim inspection lighting. The walls are light gray with a smooth-to-rough mottled texture and damp lower surfaces. A shallow brownish water layer runs along the bottom, with yellow-brown staining concentrated on the lower left and right walls. A thin dark-brown curved band follows the upper inner circumference, with slight unevenness along its edges.

A circular concrete pipe extends into a dark central opening. Lighting is dim, with brighter gray walls near the camera and a black interior beyond. The concrete surface is smooth to lightly rough and damp, with shallow water along the bottom. Pale yellow-brown bands run along the upper-left and right wall edges. A thin dark line is visible near the upper center.

A circular concrete pipe interior is lit by a camera lamp. The walls are light gray, rough, and uneven, with darker damp-looking areas along the lower perimeter. A shallow dark band follows the bottom curve, which contains gray sediment and an irregular jagged edge. Pale whitish lumpy patches and yellow-brown staining appear across the lower center, with a thin brown horizontal strip partly embedded there.

A circular gray pipe extends toward a dark central opening. The interior is dimly lit, with a smooth-to-rough mottled surface. Pale gray areas cover the upper wall, while yellow-brown staining spreads along the lower left and right sides. A shallow dark wet-looking band lies along the bottom. Thin irregular lines are visible near the right wall and lower inner rim.

A circular gray concrete pipe extends into a dark tunnel. Dim lighting creates a black central passage, with shallow dark water covering the bottom. The walls are rough and wet, with pale whitish patches and yellow-brown staining along both sides, especially the lower walls. Thin dark vertical lines and uneven ridges appear on the left and right surfaces. Green outlined arrows and white text overlays are visible.

A gray, roughly textured concrete pipe interior fills the image under bright camera lighting. No visible water surface is present. A thin dark-brown curved line runs across the lower-middle wall, with a narrow pale strip alongside it. On the right, this line rises diagonally toward the upper-right edge. The surrounding concrete is mottled light gray with scattered darker speckles.

A large circular concrete pipe extends into the distance under dim lighting. The walls are dark gray, rough, and glossy with moisture. Shallow dark water covers the bottom, reflecting the tunnel. Pale, crusty patches and streaks appear around the inner ring, especially on the left and upper areas. Numerous thin pale strands hang from the ceiling and upper-left wall. Concentric circular joints or rings are visible farther inside.

A circular gray concrete pipe extends into a dim tunnel, illuminated by the inspection camera. Shallow dark water runs along the bottom center. The walls are rough and mottled, with wet dark bands and scattered pale patches. A large tangled brown-gray fibrous mass hangs from the upper-left wall and protrudes across the channel, with several yellow strands. The pipe surface appears uneven around this area.

A round concrete pipe is shown in dim lighting, with shallow dark water covering the bottom. The gray-brown walls are rough and heavily wet, with pale crusty patches around the upper arch and along both sides. A wide pale raised strip runs from the top center downward and bends toward the right wall. A dark circular opening is visible ahead, with scattered irregular white deposits on the interior surface.

A dim, arched circular concrete pipe extends into the distance. Dark water covers the bottom, reflecting the camera light. The walls are gray-brown, rough, and wet, with extensive pale whitish crusty patches along the upper arch and side walls. A long pale strip runs from the upper center toward the right wall, where a short section protrudes inward. Blackness is visible at the far opening.

A circular gray concrete pipe narrows toward a dark central opening. Its walls are rough and mottled, with damp reflective areas and a shallow water strip along the bottom. Pale whitish patches and streaks appear around the inner circumference, especially upper-left and right. The upper rim is uneven and jagged, with small irregular gaps and raised flakes.

Circular concrete pipe viewed into a dark, damp interior. The gray walls are rough and mottled, with pale yellow-white patches around the upper rim and left side. A shallow dark water surface runs along the bottom. Several thin tan strands extend from the upper-right and left wall toward the center, with small pale clumps attached. A dark vertical seam-like line is visible on the right interior wall.

A rounded, arched concrete pipe extends into the distance. The interior is pale gray with heavily rough, uneven walls and mottled white patches. Dark water covers roughly the lower half, reflecting the walls. The far opening is nearly black. Dark vertical and horizontal streaks appear along the side walls, with irregular texture around the upper arch.

A circular concrete pipe extends into a dim, shadowed interior. The walls are gray, rough, uneven, and damp-looking, with darker discoloration across the lower and central areas. Shallow water or a wet reflective surface is visible along the bottom. Pale vertical and branching lines appear on the inner walls, with a large irregular light-gray raised or peeling area on the right side.

Circular pipe interior viewed into darkness, lit by the inspection camera. The concrete surface is dark gray, rough, wet, and speckled with small pale spots. A pale irregular strip runs downward from the upper center, with several light chunks projecting along it. A bright curved pale band follows the right inner wall. The lower center contains a dark circular recess with a bluish reflection. No standing water is clearly visible.

Circular concrete pipe interior with dark gray, wet-looking walls and scattered light specks. A pale yellow-brown band runs along the upper-left rim. Near the upper center is an irregular pale orange vertical streak extending downward from a lighter horizontal patch. A dark vertical line appears on the right wall. The lower center contains a bright-edged circular opening or reflective pool area.

Circular pipe interior with dark gray, wet, reflective walls. A shallow layer of dark water is visible along the bottom. Pale beige material forms a broad band along the upper-left edge and a rounded patch at the lower center. Near the center, an irregular raised, folded-looking section projects inward, with a pale yellow-brown vertical streak and curved layered lines above it. Small scattered light specks appear across the walls.

Circular concrete pipe opening with a rough, light-gray ring and dark interior. The lower interior contains a shallow reflective water layer. Inner surfaces are gray and damp-looking, with horizontal ribbed texture. Reddish-brown patches appear along the left and right walls, while dark vertical lines and uneven edges are visible around the opening. A pale angular protrusion extends from the upper-right area. Green overlay markings and text are visible.

A circular gray concrete pipe is shown under dim lighting, with a dark, wet lower interior and a small reflective water surface at the bottom. The walls are rough and mottled. A pale crusty buildup spans the lower-left area, with thin white strands hanging from its edge. The upper center has a large irregular dark opening with uneven edges. A reddish-brown narrow strip runs diagonally downward near the right side, beside a dark curved line.

A circular gray concrete pipe is viewed under dim, uneven lighting. The walls are rough and damp, with dark wet areas near the lower center. A pale gray curved mass extends from the left wall across the middle, with thin white strands hanging beneath it. The upper wall has an irregular dark-edged opening with exposed brown and black strips. A narrow brown vertical strip runs down the right side.

A circular gray concrete pipe extends into a dark central opening. The walls are rough, speckled, and damp, with darker staining along the lower section. Shallow dark water covers the bottom, reflecting small bright points. A narrow dark line runs diagonally along the lower-left wall, beside an uneven dark-edged strip. Lighting is dim, with the upper walls appearing lighter than the floor.

Curved concrete pipe interior, viewed obliquely. The right and upper surfaces are pale gray, rough, and speckled, with darker damp-looking shading toward the left and lower edge. A thin, dark, irregular line runs diagonally near the upper-left wall, with a small branching mark near its right end. No visible standing water, holes, or major deformation. Green arrow and text overlays are present.

A dim, close view of a gray, curved concrete pipe interior. The surface appears rough and damp, with scattered pale reflections and darker gray streaks. A narrow, irregular pale vertical band runs near the center-left, with thin dark lines extending along the surrounding wall. No standing water level is clearly visible. Green arrow and text overlays appear near the lower center.

A circular gray concrete pipe interior fills the view, with rough, damp-looking walls and scattered reflective droplets. The passage is dark, with no clearly visible waterline. A pale vertical streak runs along the left wall. On the upper-right interior is an irregular dark angular area bordered by pale lines, with a smaller pale-edged mark nearby. Green arrows and Chinese overlay text are visible across the image.

A circular gray concrete pipe is viewed from inside, with dim lighting and shallow water covering the bottom. The walls are rough and damp, with darker wet staining along the lower sides. A dark, irregular diagonal line runs from the upper-left edge toward the top center, and a narrow dark vertical line appears near the upper-right wall. The upper surfaces are lighter and mottled.

A gray, cylindrical concrete pipe extends into a dark central opening. The upper walls are pale gray and rough, with mottled texture and scattered light patches. The lower walls appear darker and wet, with a shallow reflective water layer along the bottom. A small yellow-brown stain is visible on the upper-left wall, and a thin irregular dark line runs near the upper center.

A circular gray concrete pipe extends into the distance under dim lighting. The walls are smooth but mottled, with damp, darker areas along the lower half. A pale, uneven crusty band runs horizontally across the lower-middle circumference. The bottom appears dark and wet, with a shallow reflective water surface. The far opening is shadowed, and the inner circular rings are unevenly visible.

Circular gray concrete pipe viewed along its length. The upper walls are light gray and dry-to-damp with a rough, mottled texture; the lower portion is darker and wet, with a shallow reflective water layer. A thin dark irregular line follows the upper rim. On the right wall, a jagged elongated opening or gap exposes a brownish edge. A narrow bright white vertical streak is visible near the top center.

A circular gray concrete pipe extends into the distance under dim, diffuse lighting. Dark, reflective water covers the lower portion, with a visible horizontal waterline. The walls are rough and damp, with darker staining along the lower sides. A large irregular round, dark-edged ring surrounds the central passage. A pale yellow-brown curved band appears on the upper-left wall, with a lighter curved patch upper-right and scattered small white specks.

A rough gray concrete pipe interior is shown under uneven camera lighting. A large, irregular oval dark opening occupies the center, with jagged, uneven edges. The lower rim is mottled pale gray, beige, pink, and yellow-brown, appearing damp and slightly reflective. The upper and side surfaces are coarse and granular. No distinct water level is visible. Green labels and an arrow overlay the image.

Circular gray concrete pipe viewed toward a dark central opening. The interior is dimly lit, with a darker wet-looking strip along the bottom and pale granular patches on both lower sidewalls. The surface is rough and mottled. A narrow dark curved line follows the upper inner circumference, with a small light-colored irregular patch near the top center.

Circular gray concrete pipe viewed toward a smaller concentric opening. The surface is smooth to moderately rough, with darker wet-looking shading along the lower interior and a shallow dark water area at the bottom. A yellow-brown patch appears on the upper-left wall. A pale rough band follows the right side of the inner ring. A thin jagged dark line runs diagonally on the left wall. Green inspection text overlays the center.

A circular gray concrete pipe is viewed lengthwise under dim lighting. A shallow layer of dark, reflective water covers the bottom. The walls are rough and damp, with greenish-yellow staining along the upper-left and upper-right areas. A pale segmented ring surrounds the inner wall near the opening. A thin irregular dark line runs downward along the left side, with a small jagged light-edged area beside it.

A circular gray concrete pipe is viewed in dim lighting. Dark, still water fills the lower portion, with a clear horizontal waterline across the image. The walls are mostly smooth but damp, with curved concentric bands. A pale irregular streak appears along the lower-left wall, and a thin light vertical streak is visible on the right wall. No obvious holes or protruding shapes are visible.

Circular gray concrete pipe viewed from inside, with a dark central passage and shallow, dark reflective water along the bottom. The walls are smooth to moderately rough, damp, and marked by pale horizontal streaks. A thin irregular pale line runs along the lower-left wall and floor area. Green arrow and text overlays appear near the center.

A circular concrete pipe interior fills the frame, viewed toward a darkened distance. The walls are pale gray-beige with a smooth but slightly mottled, damp-looking surface. Camera lighting is brighter near the foreground and fades toward the center. Thin dark irregular lines are visible across the upper wall and crown. No clear water surface, holes, protrusions, or major deformation is visible. Green text and an arrow overlay the image.

Circular gray concrete pipe viewed lengthwise, with dim lighting and a dark, shallow wet area along the bottom. The walls are rough and mottled, with a pale, crusty patch near the upper center. A thin dark vertical line runs down the right wall, and the lower-left surface appears darker and damp. The circular inner rim is uneven in texture but retains its rounded shape.

A circular gray concrete pipe is viewed from inside, with a rounded upper arch and dim lighting. The walls are smooth to moderately rough, mottled gray, and damp near the bottom. Shallow dark water covers the lower section with bright reflections. Pale irregular crusty material lies along the lower-left floor and bottom edge. A narrow light-colored jagged strip runs vertically down the right wall. Green graphic markings and text overlay the center.

Circular concrete pipe viewed into a dark tunnel. The upper and side surfaces are gray, rough, and damp, with a yellow-brown band along the rim. A shallow layer of murky water covers the bottom, reflecting light and containing scattered pale patches. A thin dark vertical line runs down the right wall, with a bright narrow strip beside it; a faint pale line appears near the center.

A circular pale-gray concrete pipe is viewed along its length under diffuse camera lighting. The walls are rough and mottled, with darker damp-looking shading toward the lower center. A thin dark line follows the upper-right circumferential seam, with a small uneven dark patch near its right end. The pipe narrows into a darker round opening at the bottom center. Green overlay text and an arrow are visible across the image.

A circular gray concrete pipe is viewed from inside. The walls are rough and lightly speckled, with a darker wet lower section reflecting light. A thin pale curved band crosses the lower-middle area. A narrow dark, uneven line runs from the upper-left wall across the upper interior toward the right side. The upper wall is lighter gray; the bottom is shadowed and nearly black.

A circular gray concrete pipe extends into a dark tunnel. Shallow dark water covers the bottom, with scattered pale white and yellowish patches on the wet channel surface. The walls are rough, damp, and mottled, with a horizontal lighter band around mid-height. Thin dark lines appear near the lower left and lower right wall edges. Green text and an arrow overlay the center-right area.

Circular gray concrete pipe viewed from the entrance, with a rounded interior and dim lighting toward the distance. A shallow reflective layer of water covers the bottom, containing scattered pale and yellow-brown flecks. The walls are smooth-to-rough gray, with darker damp areas near the lower sides. A pale whitish ring surrounds the opening, and a thin dark irregular line follows parts of its upper edge.

A cylindrical gray concrete pipe extends into a dark circular opening. The walls are rough, ridged, and wet, with reflective patches and scattered pale and brown stains. A shallow dark water channel runs along the bottom. Dense pale-to-brown fibrous strands spread from the lower-left and lower-right edges across the center and bottom, partially covering the passage. Small dark spots and thin protruding strands are visible on the walls.

A circular, dark pipe opening is centered within a rough, weathered concrete surface. The concrete is gray-brown with mottled patches and scattered pale spots; a bright blue band runs across the lower portion. The pipe interior is nearly black with a lighter gray patch near the upper center. Several small pale rectangular pieces or protrusions appear near the lower interior, with a light rectangular object at the bottom edge.

Circular concrete pipe interior, viewed toward a dark opening. The walls are gray, rough, and wet, with reflective moisture. Shallow dark water covers the bottom. A pale vertical strip or protruding piece runs near the center. Blue pipe fittings with a red cap are attached near the upper-right, beside a yellow-brown stained area along the right wall. A thin dark vertical line appears on the left side.

A circular concrete pipe extends into the distance under dim lighting. The gray walls are rough, mottled, and wet, with pale whitish patches throughout. Yellow-brown staining forms a band around much of the lower and side walls. Dark water covers the bottom, with rippled reflections. Thin dark vertical streaks and small uneven protrusions are visible along the upper-right interior.

A circular concrete pipe is shown in dim lighting. The gray walls are rough and wet, with a reflective water surface covering roughly the lower half. Pale whitish patches appear along the upper arch, while a yellow-brown vertical stain is visible on the left wall. A thin dark horizontal line runs across both side walls near the waterline.

A circular tunnel recedes toward a dark central opening. Shallow water covers the bottom and reflects bright highlights. The walls are rough, predominantly blue-green concrete with pale gray and white patches around the upper-right and crown. Yellow-brown staining runs along both lower side walls and the bottom edge. A small green linear marking appears near the upper center, with uneven surface texture throughout.
